shared_elements: incised/carved framing lines enclosing the main field
repeating geometric ornament (diamond lattice in A, rosette band in B)
justification: The only correspondence is the generic one of a bordered field containing repeating geometric ornament, something any carving tradition could produce independently. A shows no living beings at all, only an arched frame filled with a diamond lattice above rounded shapes, whereas B shows a naturalistic procession of human figures leading a two-humped camel between rosette bands, so the depicted subjects have essentially nothing in common.
